name: Udyam Registration
authority: Ministry of MSME, Government of India
summary: Free government registration that formally classifies a business as Micro, Small or Medium and unlocks eligibility for every other scheme on this list.
why_template: Any {category} enterprise should register on the Udyam portal first — it's the prerequisite ID for {name_lower} and most other schemes below.

name: PMEGP — Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
summary: Credit-linked capital subsidy (15–35%) for setting up a new micro-enterprise in manufacturing or service.
why_template: New or early-stage {category} businesses under ₹5 crore turnover can apply for a subsidised project loan.

name: CGTMSE — Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises
summary: Lets banks lend to micro and small enterprises without collateral, since the government guarantees a large share of the loan.
why_template: Collateral-free credit up to ₹5 crore is available for {category} enterprises — useful if inventory financing is a constraint.

name: PMMY — Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
summary: Collateral-free loans up to ₹10 lakh (Shishu / Kishor / Tarun slabs) for small trading, retail and service businesses.
why_template: A {sector} business at this scale typically fits the Kishor or Tarun MUDRA loan slab for working-capital or expansion needs.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
summary: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople (weavers, tailors, potters, etc.) — toolkit incentive, skill training and collateral-free credit.
why_template: If the business involves artisan or handicraft production, this scheme adds toolkit support on top of credit access.

name: TReDS — Trade Receivables Discounting System
summary: Lets an MSME auction unpaid invoices from large buyers to financiers and get paid early, instead of waiting 60–90 days.
why_template: If receivables from larger buyers are tying up cash flow, {name_lower} converts unpaid invoices into faster cash.

name: RAMP — Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance
summary: State-level support for market access, technology upgrade and formalisation, including help with e-commerce onboarding.
why_template: Useful for {category} businesses looking to formalise operations and get discovered by more customers online.

name: Tamil Nadu NEEDS — New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme
authority: Government of Tamil Nadu, MSME Department
summary: State subsidy and interest-free loan component for first-generation entrepreneurs setting up an enterprise in Tamil Nadu.
why_template: Available specifically to Tamil Nadu-registered {category} enterprises — worth checking alongside central schemes.

name: Interest Subvention Scheme for MSMEs
summary: 2% interest subvention on incremental fresh/existing working-capital loans for GST-registered MSMEs.
why_template: If working capital (inventory financing) is a bottleneck, this lowers the effective interest rate on that loan.
